text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three long years I've spent
alongside Mejiro
Ardan, carving out a
moment to remember, have
come to an
end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She truly left a trail of light during the
Twinkle
Series, an accomplishment that
will be talked
about for generations to
come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But her story isn't over yet. No... She'll
continue
to run, rivals at her side.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe! I see that the two of you have
improved
further still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! My timing was all wrong! But I
won't be
making that mistake next time!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I could say the same. I missed the win
this time,
but when next we meet, both
of you will bear
witness to my victory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, you're the one who's going to see me cross the finish line, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me—we have a meeting
scheduled
right now, don't we? I
apologize.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You need to go, Ardan? Thanks for
the race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This matter is not yet settled. We must
race
again, and soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we can race as many times as you
like... I
shall look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, if you'll excuse me.
Let's be off
then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In this moment, Chiyono O, Yaeno, and I
are all
able to push one another forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This, too, was made possible thanks to
all the
other moments we've been
through, Trainer.
You've helped connect
those two to my future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Allow me once again... to express my
deepest
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: 俺は君のトレーナーだから
私は貴方のトレーナーだから

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...
choice_data_list: これからも“未来”を描けるよう頑張るよ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Recently, I finally learned how to look
forward to
things—to see beyond the
present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see Chiyono O, Yaeno, and I
continuing to push
one another as we
aim for greater heights...
choice_data_list: それは、どんな“未来”なんだ？
それは、どんな“未来”なの？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And next to me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see you, as if nothing has changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...That's the future I see.
